title: stachys ballota
intro: Stachys ballota, commonly known as Wood Betony, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and alleviating headaches. The therapeutic actions of Stachys ballota include its sedative, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a popular natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
